modelConstraints.note: Up to eight temporal images including endpoints on gateways with keyframes support. Length equals the audio, at most 361 frames per fps. adapters.sceneWritingGuide: Place each cast member at their opening landmark. Pair their face and voice with the same cast ID. Keep every turn with its action and show what the listener does.

modelConstraints.note: Server-selected MSR deployment; no model parameter. 1..5 PNG/JPEG references: up to four subjects plus one background. Width/height multiples of 64; 8k+1 frames in 25..361. Speech and effects are rendered natively; an optional character voice sample on subject 1 or 2 sets the timbre of that speaker, and the dialogue goes in the prompt.

modelConstraints.note: MiniMax H3 open platform. 4-15 s (Max 5-15), 24 fps, native stereo audio always on. Up to 9 pictures and 3 voice samples (2-15 s each, 15 s total); 5 pictures free (Max 2). No seed.
